svg.title: The teacher/grader loop
svg.desc: Human chess books feed a teacher model, which studies the incumbent configuration's failures on training puzzles and proposes two candidate skill and tool configurations per round. Candidates pass a leak check that bans positions, puzzle IDs and solution lines, then the grader scores them on 120 development puzzles. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if the one-sided 95% lower bound of its paired improvement is above zero; otherwise it is rejected. A sealed test vault of 240 puzzles plus 240 color-mirrored copies is opened once, after the final round.
